title: Mixed Event — A Bright Future!! — Episode5 What Was Said and Unsaid

meta.Episode: Episode5 — What Was Said and Unsaid
meta.Event Outline: Bit by bit, the members of Leo/need continue preparations for their first show together. Their new song is coming along well, and all that's left is for Ichika to add her lyrics. She's determined to express the feelings that Saki put into the composition, but will it be so easy...?

rows.Line: Main Street

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(*Sigh*
I can't get into a good rhythm...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(My voice just isn't there.
That's probably why so few people are stopping to listen too.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Trying to sing while something's on my mind really isn't good, is it...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I-Iori...?!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Long time no see. Ichika, right?
Fancy seeing you here.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, well...
I didn't realize you were here.
Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Yeah, I was sort of in the neighborhood.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: But I'm a little disappointed...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Compared to when I saw you the other day, your voice lacked power.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: When you opened for our show that time, you did everything you could to make sure everybody knew how you felt through your song.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
But your performance just now...
I mean, it's like you were lost or something. As if you're not sure about what to do next, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Looks like I was right...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Are you free after this?
I'd like to chat a little.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line: Welcome. What can I get you?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Not sure. Any recommendations?

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line: In that case, would you like to try our cold-brewed iced coffee? It has a very fruity aroma to it.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: That sounds nice. Then, I'll have one of those.

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line:
Of course. Thank you very much.
And what would you like...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, I'll have the same...

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line:
Two cold-brewed iced coffees.
Just give me one moment.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Hehe. Strange, isn't it?
Us sitting together at a cafe like this...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, it is. I'm starting to tense up a little...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Relax, will you?
All that stress is gonna make you clam up.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Anyway, is something going on...?
I'd like to help if I can.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Actually...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: As a result, I haven't really been able to write lyrics that does her song justice...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: That's a pretty tough one. It really is hard to find the right words, sometimes.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You find it hard sometimes too?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Of course.
I have my own system for writing lyrics now, but it was rough when I was just starting out.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I listen to all these songs by so many different artists to learn how they expressed themselves and tried copying them...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: But when I realized that I should just go my own way, everything became so much easier.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Go my own way...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... Would you mind showing me how you go about writing lyrics, Iori?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I still don't really know what my way is, which is clearly why I'm having so much trouble right now...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Sure...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: This is just me talking, but I try to come up with the best way for me to get my thoughts across through any particular song.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Some people do that in a pretty circuitous manner, but I try to just say what I'm feeling.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That means you're able to say what you really want through your songs...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's so cool...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I've been listening to STANDOUT songs quite a bit, and I keep thinking that it's so cool how all of your lyrics, even when you throw in some clever twists, fit their respective songs so well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I wish I could write lyrics the way you do, but I just can't. I don't know how to express my thoughts.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Hey, can I ask you this...?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: You just said that you wish you could write lyrics the way I do... Why's that?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wh-Why...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Because they sound so cool.
I could listen to them over and over again...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: That might be what's causing all this, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I think you're putting too much stock into making your lyrics sound cool, novel or whatever, you know?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Honestly, when I'm writing, I could care less about any of those things.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Yeah, really. I mean, sure, some of the stuff I write comes out a little vague, but they're written that way because that's what I felt was best.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I try to find the right words for the best way of expressing my thoughts. That's all.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The best way to express my thoughts...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Essentially, I'd rather choose words that get my point across instead of anything that sounds cool.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Because what I absolutely don't want is for people to not understand what I'm trying to say by using some fluffy words.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's hard to understand what you're trying to say, but I get what you're trying to do...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I knew it...
That's the problem.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It never felt quite right.
These lyrics just don't do Saki's song justice and I don't know how to express her message...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I do actually want to go with lyrics that take a more direct approach...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But for some reason, it doesn't feel quite right...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Why's that?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Because it's so plain and simple...
I feel like it won't do my friend's song justice if I go with something like that.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Really? I actually believe otherwise.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Remember when you girls opened for us?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Remember how the three of you wanted to tell Hinomori that you want to make music that can touch people's hearts with her?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
And you succeeded with flying colors.
You got through to her, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Not only that, you girls managed to reach everyone that was there that day.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: So that direct approach you were talking about might be the best way to go, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: You should have more faith in yourself, Ichika, because I genuinely believe that you girls have the power to really move people.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: So try to find the right words, okay? Your words.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Iori...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, I will. Thank you so much!
